title: Harness2 ecosystem closes the retain-seed loop — but the write side is operator-curated
summary: experience-library gives causally-ordered lessons that seed propose; leak-tripwire scans overlays; eval-scenario seam maps contracts to ProbeSpecs.
hint_triggers: Ecosystem pieces landed: (1) experience-library — domain JSONL with asOf causal cutoff + token-overlap cue match (NOT substring-of-brief — direction matters); lessons are untrusted so seed blocks go through frameUntrustedInput with field/entry caps; malformed lines skip-and-count, never poison a domain. (2) leak-tripwire — fail-closed marker scan incl. nested dir errors, case-folded; applied to supplied AND LLM-proposed overlays in both sessions. (3) eval-scenario — ProbeScenarioSpec contract -> ProbeSpec. Review lessons: a feature that looks wired can be inert (seed matched nothing because the whole brief was the needle — test with realistic multi-word input); match direction and shape-validate every JSONL parse; normalize timestamps before comparing. The write side stays operator-curated — nothing auto-appends to the library yet (documented, deliberate).
